value.rationale: This is a structural classification of the first published quasi-homogeneous conic-line weak Ziegler example under the later strong-combinatorics framework. It pinpoints exactly where the pair ceases to match—at the incidence of the unique conic, already visible in r_j—so it separates weak-count failure from genuine fixed-incidence failure. That distinction is directly relevant to subsequent searches for strong conic-line Ziegler pairs and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
